how_it_works.title: From gap to submission.
how_it_works.sub: Every claim traces to a source, a quote or an analysis line.

quick_start.title: Quick start
quick_start.sub: Clone into your skills folder, install, then just ask.

feature_cards.title: Verified sources
feature_cards.text: A ledger that refuses fake, retracted and borrowed-locator references, with corrected APA.

feature_cards.title: Quotes with pages
feature_cards.text: Full texts fetched or supplied; every cited finding carries a verbatim quote and its page.

feature_cards.title: Audited numbers
feature_cards.text: Each statistic in the text is matched to its own label in the analysis output. A flipped sign fails.
